name: Mix Mode
convention: OMX-27: 27 RGB LED keys addressed by key index 0-26, exactly matching the firmware strip.setPixelColor(index, 0xRRGGBB). key 0 = AUX (top-left). keys 1-10 = the 10 black keys (top row). keys 11-26 = the 16 white keys (bottom row). Each led is a colour "#RRGGBB"; "#000000" means the LED is off. keyMap lists each key's musical note. Controls (5 pots, the encoder turn/press, and the 128x32 OLED screen) carry text notes per state. Multiple states are alternative pages/modes of the same hardware.

states.name: Mix Mode
states.notes: Classic M8 macro page 1, via the Launchpad. OMX-side view: the M8 stays in Session view. 'All' keys depend on the M8 reporting mute/solo state on the T1-T8 LEDs (verify).

keyNotes.1: Unmute all (Mute CC2 held, tap each muted track)
keyNotes.3: Go to mixer (Control Map macro on M-CH, as classic)
keyNotes.6: Unsolo all (Solo CC3 held, tap each soloed track)
keyNotes.11: Mute track 1 (Mute CC2 held, tap T1 CC101); LED mirrors T1 from the M8
